feedback: movement in the ground doesn't make sense, I teleport at the edge and I seem to move in the opposite direction when I am moving on the ground

selection.reason: Player movement logic, bounds checking (which causes teleporting at edges), and input application (which might be inverted) are all handled in the update function.

patch.notes: Fixed platform collision checks by slightly shrinking the collision bounding box along axes not currently being resolved. This prevents overlapping bounds with the floor/walls due to precision issues resulting in wrong collision resolution directions that caused teleporting or bouncing against surfaces.
